title: Andrew Plotkin - Mazes: Are We Lost Yet?
speaker: Andrew Plotkin
description:
The earliest computer adventure games had mazes. Wizardry and Ultima had mazes. The classical roguelike screen just begs to be filled with a maze. Can you say what a maze actually *is*? ... Not as easy as it looks, right?

I'll thread through some classical examples and try to show what very different genres of maze have in common. Textual, graphical, first-person or third-person: what is it about mazes that leaves you feeling lost?
